changed.title: A fixed 128 by 128 graph given by its table: some AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 1000 gates is right whenever one row and one column are on
changed.unlocks: how far below our own circuit this graph goes at 1000 gates, for the line on the unstruck rule's graph
changed.context: A search. A circuit one gate below our own construction for this graph is checked; we hold none of 1000 gates and none has been found; this is a search. Answer with a gate list (AND, OR or NOT, each reading at most two wires) and its output wire: only the gate list is checked, on the 16384 inputs with one row and one column on. changed.title: One-a-side promise: the 4 by 5 bipartite graph with mask 40310 has a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit of at most 11 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 5) => (40310 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) 11
changed.unlocks: the AND/OR cost of 4 by 5 graphs off the square, where the checked twin merge sends square graphs, for the silent-line work
changed.sketch: A search unit. We hold a circuit of 12 AND/OR gates (three plain forms, full lines taken out and equal gates merged); at this size those forms are weak; we hold none of 11; this is a search. Our count of unread rows and columns gives a floor of 8 (on paper), a gap of 4. Answer with a gate list (AND or OR, each reading at most two wires; wires 0 to 3 left, 4 to 8 right, gate j writes wire 9 + j, each gate reading only earlier wires) and its output wire, judged on all 20 inputs with one vertex on each side.

changed.sketch: We hold a circuit of 9 gates, a weak hand form (best over a few point orders and the complement plus a NOT, equal gates merged): OR(0,1), NOT(6), AND(5,7), OR(4,6), AND(3,9), AND(2,4), OR(8,10), OR(11,12), NOT(13) (inputs 0-5 are the points, gate k is wire 6 + k, output last). We hold no circuit of 8 gates; this is a search. No complete search of ours has run at six points.
